decisions.reason: As the flagship product line, closely tied to the core dental software and presented as the firm's strategic direction, it has strong management commitment, and the established firm's slack lets it keep the product through early uncertainty.

The education institute builds on the firm's existing training content and customer relationships at low incremental cost, so there is no performance shortfall severe enough to prompt problemistic search.
The remote support tool is a cheap complement to the firm's core customer support that improves service efficiency, so keeping it is consistent with routine-based satisficing.
